fields.name: Employee document type
fields.finding: No single document-type column; four document columns, overlapping for 14 employees (8 with National ID + Citizenship Card, 3 with National ID + Identity Card + Citizenship Card, 3 other combinations) Every employee has at least one. All 13 foreigners holding only 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' are non-Colombian nationals. The spec explanation describes the code list but not how the code is derived from client data.
fields.proposed_explanation: The instruction guide prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Minor ID card, 13 Citizenship ID card, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Foreign resident ID card, 31 NIT, 41 Passport. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. SOURCE (client evidence): the client employee master holds NO document-type field. It holds one column per document - 'National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID' - and 14 of 261 employees have two or three of them populated. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, not infer it from which column is filled. The mapping of the client columns to Form 220 codes must be confirmed with the client: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22 are the evident candidates; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no evident code (they appear next to a Citizenship Card for Colombian nationals).

Accumulated 'EE Citizenship Card ID' equals one of the Master Data document columns for all 261 matched employees, including foreigners' cards, so its label is misleading. Accumulated covers 1,038 payees against 261 in Master Data: the 491 pension payees are not in Master Data. fields.proposed_explanation: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number column of the employee master that matches casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'); in the client's Accumulated Report the same number appears in 'EE Citizenship Card ID', which despite its label also carries foreigners' card numbers. Do NOT use the column 'ID Number' of the Accumulated Report or of the Base of Withholding: it is the internal employee number (equal to Master Data 'Employee ID'), not an identity document. fields.name: Period certified - from
fields.finding: Three candidate start dates in two different formats; the spec says only 'the hire date'. The developer needs to know which client date to use and that the source format (DD-MM-YYYY / YYYY-MM-DD) differs from the output format AAAA MM DD.
fields.proposed_explanation: First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE (to be confirmed with the client): the client employee master carries three start dates - 'Hire Date' and 'Original Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (format YYYY-MM-DD); 'Hire Date' differs from 'Original Hire Date' for 40 of 261 employees, where the original date points to earlier service (masked example: Hire Date 01-03-2026, Original Hire Date 27-02-2014). Use the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year (candidate: 'Hire Date') and convert the source format to AAAA MM DD.

fields.name: Salary payments

report_evidence.column: F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description
E Monthly Basic Salary and Integral Salary

fields.finding: Client data supports the casilla (salary wage types per employee per month), but the spec mapping 'SUM(Payroll.Salary_Payments)' does not say which wage types feed it. The client's 30 wage types flagged 'Salary Payment Indicator' = X are not a usable casilla-36 rule (they include vacation and per-diem wage types the spec routes elsewhere). The Accumulated Report monthly columns run 01/10/2025 to 01/09/2026 (rolling 12 months, although its title line reads '01-01-2026 - 2026-09-30'), so its 'Total' column mixes two tax years and cannot feed Form 220 directly; the annual value must be the sum of the January-December monthly amounts of the tax year.
fields.proposed_explanation: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. CLIENT MAPPING: salary wage types evidenced in the client's accumulations include 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. The client's 'Salary Payment Indicator' flag ('X') must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus) and on per diems (62805-62808), which belong to casillas 42 and 43, and it is absent from other bonuses (e.g. 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus, 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up). The engine needs an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table approved by the RA. Salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) needs an RA decision. PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

fields.name: Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales

report_evidence.column: F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description

fields.finding: The client pays several benefits in kind through third parties, booked as 'Inf.' earning + equal deduction pairs (65818 and 21115 both total 1,805,980,003 over the 12 columns). The spec explains the legal categories but gives no mapping, so the developer cannot tell which client wage types feed casilla 37.
fields.proposed_explanation: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: the client books in-kind benefits paid to third parties as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 (identical totals) - and the same pattern for 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. Each must be assigned by the RA to casilla 37, 38 or 46 or to no casilla; the meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38. The offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values.

fields.name: Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)

report_evidence.column: F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description

fields.finding: The client has a recurring meal payment (65818, paid in every month) that this casilla tests. The explanation gives the thresholds but not the wage type nor that the test is monthly per employee and then summed.
fields.proposed_explanation: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: meal payments to third parties are wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, available per employee per month. Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT of the tax year (client wage type 58001 UVT); the casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.

fields.finding: Client data supports the casilla. The spec maps to generic WTC codes (CO-CESANTIAS, CO-INTERESES-CESANTIAS) but does not list the client's four payment wage types nor exclude the many cesantias provision / balance wage types in the same report.
fields.proposed_explanation: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. CLIENT MAPPING: 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments, present in most months), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (partial payments, January and March 2026) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January: COP 269.0 million in the 01/01/2026 column). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here.

fields.name: Severance savings under the traditional CST regime
fields.finding: No evidence of traditional-regime employees: earliest Hire / Original Hire Date is 2001 and earliest Adjusted Service Date is 1991. The Master Data 'Regime' value 'AReg' (8 employees) is on employees whose Hire Date is November 2025 or later, three of whom have fund deposits (25827), so it is not the pre-1991 regime flag.

fields.name: Severance savings deposited to the fund

report_evidence.column: F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description

fields.finding: Client data supports the casilla: the fund deposit is one wage type pair, paid only in February. The spec does not name it, does not warn that it appears twice (25827 and 65805), and does not say in which tax year a February deposit (for the prior 31 December balance) is certified. 61 of 261 Master Data employees have no severance fund (blank), consistent with integral-salary employees having no deposit.
fields.proposed_explanation: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. CLIENT MAPPING: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February (COP 2,064.8 million in the 01/02/2026 column). Certify the deposit in the tax year in which it is made [RA to confirm the realisation rule]. The provision wage types 22110 / 42110 are accruals, not the deposit.

fields.name: Withholding on labour and pension income

report_evidence.column: F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description
F WT Code / G WT Description

fields.finding: Client data supports the casilla, but the spec mapping 'SUM(Payroll.Income_Tax_Withheld)' hides several client choices: withholding is split over 2552, 21129 (terminations) and 21140 (retirees); notional withholding wage types (21330, 25834) sit next to real ones; the monthly working report has two withholding results (WITH / WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION). Evidence (not a decision): 2552 for September 2026 matches WITH CONTRIBUTION for 234 of 240 matched employees vs 180 for WITHOUT; CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING equals WITHOUT minus WITH where positive (e.g. 8,681,351 - 8,664,327 = 17,024). The Base of Withholding also ends with a 'GRAND TOTAL' row in column A that must be excluded. The Accumulated Report monthly columns run 01/10/2025 to 01/09/2026 (rolling 12 months, although its title line reads '01-01-2026 - 2026-09-30'), so its 'Total' column mixes two tax years and cannot feed Form 220 directly; the annual value must be the sum of the January-December monthly amounts of the tax year. In the rolling window, 3,150.9 million of 2552 sits in the October-December 2025 columns.
fields.proposed_explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source practised on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period. Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. CLIENT MAPPING: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments - COP 63.13 million in January 2026 for one employee who also had 2552 that month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional and are NOT certified; 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country need an RA decision. The client's monthly 'Base of Withholding' shows two results, 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' and 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'; which one is the withholding certified is an open decision (in September 2026 the 2552 amount equals the WITH CONTRIBUTION value for 234 of 240 matched employees and the WITHOUT value for 180). 'CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING' (WITHOUT minus WITH where positive) is not part of 2552 and is not certified here. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
